DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma

The biopsy findings of nuclear hyperchromasia, multinucleation, and increased mitotic figures, combined with the clinical presentation of an erythematous plaque with crusting and irregular borders, are highly indicative of a malignant epithelial process. The negative STD panel helps rule out infectious etiologies like syphilis. Based on these specific histological and clinical features, the diagnosis is Squamous Cell Carcinoma.
